record.original_question: Consider the Kirchhoff-type problem on a smooth bounded domain Omega subset R^4 with Dirichlet boundary condition u = 0 on dOmega, given by -(a + b integral_Omega |grad u|^2 dx) Delta u = lambda|u|^(q-2)u + delta|u|^2u for 2 < q < 4. Theorem A assumes that bS^2 < delta < 2bS^2, that Omega is strictly star-shaped, and that one of the auxiliary parameter conditions (C1) - a > 0 with lambda > 0 sufficiently small, (C2) - lambda > 0 with a > 0 sufficiently large, or (C3) - a > 0, lambda > 0, and delta/b > S^2 sufficiently close to S^2 - holds. Are these assumptions necessary in order to guarantee the existence of a solution of Eq. (1.1)?

evidence.quote: Theorem A. ([25, Theorem 1.6]) Suppose that 2 < q < 4. Let b, delta > 0 satisfy bS^2 < delta < 2bS^2 and let Omega subset R^4 be strictly star shaped. Furthermore, assume that one of the following conditions (C1), (C2) and (C3) holds: (C1) a > 0, lambda > 0 is small enough, (C2) lambda > 0, a > 0 is large enough, (C3) a > 0, lambda > 0 and delta/b > S^2 is sufficiently close to S^2, then Eq. (1.1) has a nontrivial solution.

Naimen's open question. On [25, Page 1171], Naimen asked whether conditions that mu < 2bS^2, Omega subset R^4 is strictly star-sharped and (C1)-(C3) in Theorem A are necessary to ensure the existence of the solutions of Eq. (1.1).

We study the following Brezis-Nirenberg problem of Kirchhoff type ... where Omega subset R^4 is a bounded domain with the smooth boundary dOmega, 2 <= q < 4 and a, b, lambda, delta are positive parameters.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega\subset\mathbb{R}^4$ be a bounded domain with smooth boundary $\partial\Omega$, let $a,b,\lambda,\delta>0$ be parameters, and let $2<q<4$. Consider the Kirchhoff-type Brezis–Nirenberg problem
$$-\Bigl(a+b\int_\Omega|\nabla u|^2\,dx\Bigr)\Delta u=\lambda|u|^{q-2}u+\delta|u|^2u\quad\text{in }\Omega,\qquad u=0\text{ on }\partial\Omega,\qquad(\star)$$
where $S=\inf\{\|\nabla u\|_{L^2(\Omega)}^2/\|u\|_{L^4(\Omega)}^2 : u\in H^1_0(\Omega)\setminus\{0\}\}$ is the best Sobolev constant for the embedding $H^1_0(\Omega)\hookrightarrow L^4(\Omega)$.

The following sufficient existence result is known: if $bS^2<\delta<2bS^2$, $\Omega$ is strictly star-shaped, and at least one of
\begin{itemize}
\item[(C1)] $a>0$ and $\lambda>0$ is sufficiently small,
\item[(C2)] $\lambda>0$ and $a>0$ is sufficiently large,
\item[(C3)] $a>0$, $\lambda>0$, and $\delta/b>S^2$ is sufficiently close to $S^2$,
\end{itemize}
holds, then $(\star)$ admits a nontrivial weak solution.

Question: Are the hypotheses $\delta<2bS^2$, that $\Omega$ be strictly star-shaped, and that one of the conditions (C1)–(C3) hold, all necessary in order to guarantee the existence of a nontrivial solution of $(\star)$?
artifact.status_search_result: Web searches surface follow-up works on the four-dimensional critical Kirchhoff Brezis–Nirenberg problem (e.g., existence/multiplicity papers extending Naimen's 2014 result), but no source clearly establishes whether all three sets of hypotheses (the upper bound $\delta<2bS^2$, strict star-shapedness of $\Omega$, and conditions (C1)–(C3)) are necessary. The status of the necessity question therefore appears unresolved based on available evidence.

status_evidence.title: Existence and multiplicity of positive solutions of a critical Kirchhoff type elliptic problem in dimension four
status_evidence.snippet: Studies critical Kirchhoff Brezis–Nirenberg problem in dimension four with parameter conditions extending earlier work.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent work extends but does not settle the necessity of the listed hypotheses.

status_evidence.title: On the Brezis-Nirenberg Problem with a Kirchhoff Type Perturbation
status_evidence.snippet: Naimen's paper proving existence under conditions (C1)–(C3) with strictly star-shaped Omega and bS^2<delta<2bS^2.
status_evidence.claim: This is the source of the sufficient conditions whose necessity is being questioned.

status_evidence.title: On the Brezis-Nirenberg problem for a Kirchhoff type equation in high dimension
status_evidence.snippet: Further work on Kirchhoff Brezis–Nirenberg problems; does not resolve the four-dimensional necessity question.
status_evidence.claim: Necessity of Naimen's hypotheses in dimension four remains unaddressed in this line of work.
